lore: Every channel into DiskSaver harbour is marked by a bell buoy that rings when a boat brushes past, so the harbour watch knows to inspect it. Buoy-tender Ottoline rows out each dawn and checks that every buoy hangs over a channel boats actually use. A buoy over open water rings for nobody; a used channel with no buoy lets boats slip in unseen.

lines.ringing: Every used channel has its bell, and every bell hangs where boats pass.
lines.muffled: Some bells hang over open water. Nothing slips in, but I should move them.
lines.silent: Boats are using a channel with no bell. Changes there will slip past the watch.
